intro: A collection of small moments found in the city's everyday rhythm.

albums.title: Between the Stops
albums.description: Rain-darkened streets, late windows, and the quiet pause between one place and the next.

photos.title: After the Rain
photos.caption: A shop light stretches across the stones just after the evening shower.
photos.alt: Warm shop light reflected on a rain-darkened Istanbul street

photos.title: Platform Light
photos.caption: A brief meeting of reflections and silhouettes at the end of the day.
photos.alt: Silhouettes and reflections on a city transit platform at dusk

photos.title: The Last Tram
photos.caption: The street goes quiet as the tram carries the last warm light through.
photos.alt: A tram moving through a rainy city street at night

albums.title: Long Shadows
albums.description: A study of open space, long afternoon light, and the people who give a city its scale.

photos.title: Crossing the Plaza
photos.caption: One small figure moves through a wide field of afternoon light.
photos.alt: A cyclist crossing a sunlit city plaza with long shadows

photos.title: A Little Light
photos.caption: A familiar corner changes when the day begins to close.
photos.alt: A softly lit storefront on a city street at dusk
